propositions: serverInfo 200 does not guarantee GreenHopper custom fields (Epic Link, Epic Name) are registered, creating a timing window where early field checks misattribute plugin initialization delay to image degradation

the harness readiness gate polls only serverInfo and never checks field inventory, while the probe workflow (gerrit 1387) was fixed to poll fields, creating drift between two paths that must share one definition
a system-only field inventory (zero customfield_* entries) is treated as ready by the current gate, but should read as not-ready and must be distinguished from genuine image degradation
the wait-for-fields operation lacks its own bounded budget and failure diagnostics, so an expiry provides no observable inventory dump to self-diagnose the root cause
both _assert_project_capabilities and wait_for_jira_dc_ready must route through a shared field-readiness predicate to prevent divergence and ensure one testable contract
the gate must emit field inventory in its failure message to enable the reader to discriminate 'fields not yet registered' from 'this image does not offer these fields'
